# Positive seed intervals that finite support cannot rescue in time

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every law of change with admissible disturbances and every family of levels its steps drain (within the guard is level 0, and a configuration within the guard that one admissible step takes to level k was at level k+1), a start below level n leaves the guard within n steps on every admissible history; being at level n does not suffice. A quantity whose growth on each admissible step is bounded by a monotone map stays below the map's orbit; where each admissible step lowers the level by one while the quantity's orbit k+1 steps on is at or below a threshold, every start whose orbit at step n is at or below the threshold and which is not at level n leaves the guard within n steps on every admissible history. The market is an instance, the old theorem being proved from the law, the share growing at most by 3/2 a step and each step taking one unit of the stock above the floor 5 while the share's orbit stays at or below 1/6: for every rational C0>=5 and integer N>C0-5, all positive seeds 0<x0<=(2/3)^N/6 fail by N under every time-varying beta/quality-error sequence and nonnegative support shock. The same positive state with beta=0, best initial quality and no error/extra consumption has projected finite recovery but full guarded termination.

Canonical source: [FiniteSupportObstruction.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/FiniteSupportObstruction.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The original rational State, shareStep, supportStep and essential-stock floor five remain; initial x and q are in [0,1], with the original guard at each step.
- Beta and quality error may vary arbitrarily each step, with q clipped; stock shocks are nonnegative, with no direct stock injection, entry, change of expansion rate or organizational switch.

Renewal and stock are related coordinates updated in the same activity. Time-varying control includes sequences produced by realized feedback but does not explain feedback formation. Floors and rates require actual correspondence; none ends the represented market organization only.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checks 17 new theorems / 22 declaration audits, with 123 inherited theorems / 153 audits separately rebuilt. Standard logical axiom dependencies are retained; author counterreview, no independent agent or new market observations. General laws: checker receipts bound.

The delta_N interval is a conservative obstruction, not an exact viability boundary. Actual provision, dependence change, entry or faster formation may alter it. No bifurcation, R-tipping classification, physical death or zero-added-substantive-axiom foundation is proved.

- projected_recovery_and_actual_failure retains projected recovery and actual termination for the same seed; same_stock_can_support_high_seed refutes inevitable failure from finite stock alone. [FiniteSupportObstruction.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/FiniteSupportObstruction.lean)
- Collapse.level_not_lasting: a drained family holds true at level 1, yet true does not last one step, so being at level n does not suffice. [Lasting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Lasting.lean)
